summary: (spec fidelity) The placeholder ids are not the distinct ids `canon query` reports as having no source whenever the referenced record is on disk in the ledger but not committed. graph.rs makes a placeholder only when no real node holds the id (`!nodes.contains_key(&placeholder) || ...placeholder`), while query (references::Sources) counts only committed sources. On this repo, where .canon/ledger/kind=change is gitignored and derived from the briefs, `canon query --kind subject` reports change ids canon-0-30-clippy-ci, canon-0-30-ledger-naming, canon-0-30-rust-sweep, canon-0-31-brief-format, canon-0-31-cli-ids and canon-0-31-loop as dangling, but the index holds them as non-placeholder change nodes: 239 distinct query ids vs 233 placeholders. F4 acceptance and search.graph.03 Then (sets equal) fail here; the test fixture never writes a record for a dangling id, so it cannot see it. Pick one rule (placeholder iff query reports it, or query and the index agree on the source set) and add the uncommitted-record case to search_graph_03. Blast radius: search neighbors and trace never mark these changes as sourceless; status dangling counts disagree with search.
